4210-4279-4314--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4210-4279-4314--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple, Pawn of Ulamog and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3169-3249-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3169-3249-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2976-4365-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
2976-4365-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Animate Land
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

955-1563-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
955-1563-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
955-1563-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

206-2366-5702-7288.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
206-2366-5702-7288.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

240-955-5470-6798.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat from step 2.

628-2511-7216.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Moonlit Lamenter.
When Moonlit Lamenter dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

5331-5929-6737.description:
Cast Gemcutter Buccaneer by paying {3}{R}. When it enters, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that enters as an Equipment.
When the Treasure enters, Barret triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token which enters as a Pirate due to Leyline of Transformation.
When the Rebel enters, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that enters as an Equipment.
Repeat from step 2.
5331-5929-6737.notes: The combo creates a mandatory infinite loop in step 2. This must be stopped at some point or the game ends in a draw.

1409-2097-5420.description:
Activate Plundering Pirate by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Pirate enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Plundering Pirate.
Resolve the Plundering Pirate trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

275-2034-2146-4871-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Cloud Key.
Repeat.

2079-2440-3581-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2079-2440-3581-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

147-780-6798.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 5.

1402-2218-4763-4785.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4314-5173-5553-5626.notablePrerequisites: One of Greedy Freebooter or Shambling Ghast must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard.
4314-5173-5553-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter or Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter or Shambling Ghast dies, it and Pawn of Ulamog trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter or Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning either Greedy Freebooter or Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1636-5147-6095.notablePrerequisites:
You have a Zombie creature card in your graveyard.
Creatures you control can tap to produce enough mana to cast the Zombie in your graveyard.
Zul Ashur does not have summoning sickness.
1636-5147-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting a Zombie card in your graveyard.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding enough mana to cast the Zombie.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Zombie, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1116-3240-4716-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-4716-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
When the Graveborn enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

1116-3240-5332-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-5332-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Carmen and Sek'Kuar trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Carmen and Nether Traitor trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

222-2018-2921-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Slimefoot and Squee from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Luminous Broodmoth and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Luminous Broodmoth die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from steps 1 and 6.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Luminous Broodmoth from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1461-3330-4050-4078.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1461-3330-4050-4078.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Wurmcoil Engine enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it triggers, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
When the Wurms enter the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurms, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

2292-4690-4871-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three basic lands.
2292-4690-4871-5003.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Phylath.
When Phylath dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Phylath from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Phylath enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating at least three 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Viscera Seer three times by sacrificing three Plants.
When the Plants die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers three times, creating three Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Viscera Seer abilities from steps 1 and 7, causing you to scry 1 four times.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
If you control at least four basic lands, this combo nets infinite Plant tokens, Treasure tokens and colored mana.

849-1117-1594-3689-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {R}.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it and Anax trigger.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Resolve the Workshop Assistant trigger, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Satyr, adding {R}.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {2}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {R}.
When Junk Diver dies, it and Anax trigger.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Resolve the Junk Diver trigger, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Satyr, adding {R}.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {2}.
Repeat.

405-560-2232-4050.description:
Cast Resolute Reinforcements by paying {1}{W}.
When Resolute Reinforcements enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Resolute Reinforcements trigger, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Resolute Reinforcements to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Soldiers, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

549-4385-4659.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Sliver token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1378-1548.notablePrerequisites:
Mirage Phalanx is paired with Port Razer.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1378-1548.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mirage Phalanx and Port Razer each trigger, creating a token copy of Mirage Phalanx and Port Razer with haste.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the Port Razer token.
The Port Razer token triggers, untapping each creature you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, the Mirage Phalanx and Port Razer tokens each trigger, exiling themselves.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-2178-4242-4331.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Drafna.
Drafna does not have summoning sickness.
2034-2178-4242-4331.description:
Cast Su-Chi by paying {4}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying the Su-Chi spell.
Resolve the copy of the Su-Chi spell, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Su-Chi token, adding {C}{C}.
The token Su-Chi dies, triggering itself and Drafna.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Drafna trigger, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

261-476-1636.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {G}.
261-476-1636.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Questing Phelddagrif's first ability by paying {G}, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn and causing target opponent to create a 11 Hippo creature token.
The Hippo enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm and Suture Priest's second ability.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing the Hippo token's controller to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1808-4694.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill a creature.
1808-4694.description:
Kill a creature.
The creature dies, triggering Eloise's first ability, creating a Clue token.
The Clue token becomes a 0/0 creature due to March of the Machines, and then dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Repeat from step 2.

803-2692-3510.notablePrerequisites:
You have not played a land this turn.
"Saproling" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
You have a land in hand.
803-2692-3510.description:
Play a land from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Felidar Retreat, creating a 2/2 Cat Beast creature token.
The token enters the battlefield, triggering Felidar Retreat, creating a 2/2 Cat Beast creature token.
Repeat step 3.

1479-2055-3390-5129.notablePrerequisites: You have an additional permanent in hand that you can play this turn.
1479-2055-3390-5129.description:
Play the permanent from your hand, triggering Kodama of the East Tree on ETB.
With the Kodama of the East Tree trigger on the stack, sacrifice Lotus Bloom for {W}{W}{W} and spend two of it to activate Auriok Salvagers, returning Lotus Bloom to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Lotus Bloom onto the battlefield.
Pay {2} for the Mirrorworks trigger, creating a token copy of Lotus Bloom.
Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Before the trigger resolves, sacrifice the token Lotus Bloom copy for {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
